title: Polyfluorene-based electrolyte membrane for hydrogen/oxygen gas separation under humidified conditions
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01692K, Paper
Shoji Miyanishi, Kaede Matsuta, Takeo Yamaguchi
Hydrogen/oxygen separation under wet conditions has recently become important in the production of hydrogen. This study developed an electrolyte membrane, PFST-C8-SO3H, with a poly(fluorene-alt-tetrafluorophenylene) backbone and achieved high hydrogen/oxygen separation...
